name: food-ordering-system
description: Bootstrap scripts for the full food ordering system workspace.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix restaurant && npm install --prefix delivery
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client,restaurant,delivery -c green,cyan,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client start" "npm --prefix restaurant start" "npm --prefix delivery start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix restaurant run build && npm --prefix delivery run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix client test -- --watchAll=false && npm --prefix restaurant test -- --watchAll=false && npm --prefix delivery test -- --watchAll=false
